senses.gloss: f. (preced. wds.) boiling pot; מעשה ר׳ a cooked dish.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Nedarim 6:2">Ned. VI, 2</cite> (<cite ref="Nedarim 49a:1">49ᵃ</cite>) <he>הנודר ממעשה קדרה אינו אסור אלא ממ׳ ר׳</he> (Rashi <cite ref="T01128"><he>רְתַחְתָּא</he></cite>) if a person vows abstinence from ‘what is made in a pot’, he is forbidden only boiled dishes; Y. ib. 39ᶜ bot. <cite ref="T00457"><he>רותחנה</he></cite> (corr. acc.).
